climate: mostly moist cool and moist warm zones
comparison: cover crop vs. bare fallow control
metric: grain yield change of primary crop
quote: Overall, the cover crops significantly decreased grain yield of the primary crops compared to the control treatments (on average −4%; p < 0.001; n = 154) (Figure 2b).
note: Pools all primary crops (wheat, barley, oats, corn and others); no corn- or soybean-specific yield effect reported. Most studies were 2-3 yr long.

comparison: cover crop vs. bare fallow control
metric: grain yield change of primary crop
quote: Both legume and non‐legume cover crops significantly decreased (p < 0.001; n = 52 and p < 0.01; n = 96 respectively) grain yield of the primary crop whilst legume–non‐legume mixed cover crops significantly increased (p < 0.01; n = 6) grain yield of the primary crop (by ≈13%).
note: Printed as approximately 13%. Legume (n=52) and non-legume (n=96) cover crops significantly decreased yield, but no percentages are given in the text (Figure 2b only). Pools all primary crops, not corn/soybean specific.
